achievements.name: The Provider
achievements.description: Produce a lot of stuff natively.

achievements.name: The Bureaucrat
achievements.description: Gained by having your papers in order. Increases admin.

achievements.name: The Caretaker
achievements.description: Gained by having proper access to hospitals. Increases health.

achievements.name: The Clumsy
achievements.description: Gained by living through multiple accidents. Makes people a bit more cautious in your presence.

achievements.name: The Drunkard
achievements.description: Gained by having lots of drunk subjects. Increases drink production.

achievements.name: The Entertainer
achievements.description: Gained by having good access to entertainment and repeatedly shouting 'Are you not entertained?' at the screen. Increases happiness.

achievements.name: The Gourmand
achievements.description: Gained by having lots of food. Increases food production.

achievements.name: The Merciful
achievements.description: Gained by being a saint after battles. Adds some loyalty to your name.

achievements.name: The merciless
achievements.description: Gained by being harsh on your conquered foes. Slaves will be more easily controlled.

achievements.name: The Pleasurer
achievements.description: Gained by having good access to Massage Parlour. Increases happiness.

achievements.name: The Undefeated
achievements.description: Gained by being a badass on the field of battle. Increases morale and detriments raids.

achievements.name: The Uniter
achievements.description: Gained by absorbing a lot of kingdoms.

achievements.name: The Wise
achievements.description: Gained by being a knowledge nerd. Increases knowledge and education rates.

achievements.name: The Artisan
achievements.description: Gained by workshop output. Increases productivity of all workshops.

achievements.name: Breaker of Chains
achievements.description: Gained by freeing many slaves.

achievements.name: The Child of the Sun
achievements.description: Have loads of farms and orchards.

achievements.name: First of Their Name
achievements.description: Gained by having 1500 happy people and increases your starting population and supplies of new games.

achievements.name: Heaviest of Hands
achievements.description: Gained by a lot of executions. Increases law.

achievements.name: Herdsman of Entelodonts
achievements.description: Have loads of Entelodont pastures.

achievements.name: Lifebringer
achievements.description: Cure a lot of people in the hospital.

achievements.name: Lord of the Seven Kingdoms
achievements.description: Control 7 regions to gain this ancient and prestigious title.

achievements.name: Richest of Kings
achievements.description: Decreases inflation, allowing you to amass even greater wealth.

achievements.name: Warden of the North
achievements.description: Survive and thrive in a cold climate to gain the goodwill of its hardened people.

achievements.name: Ruler of Sedge and Bee
achievements.description: Survive and thrive in a hot climate to gain the goodwill of its hardened people.

achievements.name: Seer of the Gods
achievements.description: A ruler making his people pay homage to the spiritual realm. Surely the gods reward such piety.

achievements.name: The Builder
achievements.description: Build a bunch of fancy buildings on the world map.

achievements.name: The Conquerer
achievements.description: Gained by killing your enemies.

achievements.name: The Great
achievements.description: Gained by having many people follow and love you.

achievements.name: The Mad
achievements.description: Have a bunch of insane people running around in your city.

achievements.name: The Nudist
achievements.description: Keep your citizens naked, and gain an extra boost to exposure.

achievements.name: Protector of the Realm
achievements.description: Gained by defending against invasions.

achievements.name: The Slaver
achievements.description: Gained by having many slaves.

achievements.name: The Usurper
achievements.description: Kill a couple of foreign royalties to gain this lucrative title.

achievements.name: Ruler of Kings
achievements.description: A master of Syx, a title only granted to the greats.
